title: Confidence in US institutions mired near record low
discussion_signal: Replies disagree about why institutional confidence is low, attributing it to leaders, long-running party strategy, money, institutional failure, or public disengagement. The thread also contains a counter-signal: some participants still describe trust in particular institutions or argue that explanations are too politically one-sided.
linked_research_question: How a measured trust signal becomes competing causal stories, blame, identity, and possible demands for institutional accountability.
engagement: 228 visible votes in the indexed result; visibility is not prevalence or agreement.
limits: Highly partisan discussion and moderation context
Comments show interpretation, not verified political action or institutional change
